name: Chartered Accountant
shortDescription: Use accounting, audit, tax, and finance expertise to help businesses meet obligations and plan responsibly.
goalDefinition: Goal: become ready for an entry-level Chartered Accountant role or the relevant formal qualification, from Class 12 through the CA Foundation route. Formal exams, admissions, registration, hiring, and market conditions can change the actual finish date.
overview: Use accounting, audit, tax, and finance expertise to help businesses meet obligations and plan responsibly. Progress usually combines structured learning, deliberate practice, and feedback. Your exact route depends on your subjects, location, eligibility, and the latest official requirements.

education: Class 12 in any stream can enter the CA Foundation route subject to current ICAI rules.
Complete the current ICAI exams and required practical training.
exams: CA Final and required practical training
eligibility: Confirm subject, age, category, and location requirements from the relevant official authority before applying.
Build the required foundational knowledge and keep academic or professional records ready.
Do not treat this estimated roadmap as a substitute for current admission or recruitment notices.

name: Stock Market Trader/Investor
shortDescription: Research listed companies and markets using a documented, risk-aware investing process; returns are never guaranteed.
goalDefinition: Goal: follow a documented research, diversification, and risk-management process; this does not promise income or investment returns.
overview: Research listed companies and markets using a documented, risk-aware investing process; returns are never guaranteed. Progress usually combines structured learning, deliberate practice, and feedback. Your exact route depends on your subjects, location, eligibility, and the latest official requirements. Treat trading as high risk: do not use borrowed money, do not rely on guaranteed-return claims, and check SEBI guidance before acting.
